baseball_diamond: a satellite image of baseball_diamond with a diamond-shaped infield and compact sports-ground structure, different from stadium by smaller scale and weaker enclosure.
beach: a satellite image of beach with bright sand-like shoreline and clear contact with water, different from harbor by lacking port infrastructure and from desert by coastal water boundary.
bridge: a satellite image of bridge with a narrow crossing over water or land, different from overpass by weaker road-over-road pattern and from harbor by lacking strong maritime dock context.
dense_residential: a satellite image of dense_residential with very compact housing layout and tightly packed roofs, different from sparse_residential by much smaller spacing between buildings.
desert: a satellite image of desert with dry barren texture and limited vegetation, different from beach by lacking a clear shoreline and from chaparral by weaker shrub texture.
forest: a satellite image of forest with dense continuous tree canopy and dark natural texture, different from meadow by stronger canopy continuity and from rectangular_farmland by lacking regular parcels.
harbor: a satellite image of harbor with docks, vessels, and shore-adjacent port organization, different from bridge by lacking a simple crossing structure and from parking_lot by stronger water-adjacent context.
intersection: a satellite image of intersection with compact crossing roads and transport-node geometry, different from overpass by weaker elevated overlap and from parking_lot by lacking regular vehicle rows.
meadow: a satellite image of meadow with broad open grass-covered land and weak structural boundaries, different from forest by lacking dense canopy and from rectangular_farmland by lacking regular field parcels.
overpass: a satellite image of overpass with elevated crossing and visible grade separation, different from bridge by stronger road-over-road transport pattern and from intersection by clearer layered elevation.
parking_lot: a satellite image of parking_lot with organized rows of parked vehicles on open paved ground, different from industrial_area by lacking heavy factory compounds and from runway by lacking a long straight strip.
railway: a satellite image of railway with linear parallel tracks and strong rail transport texture, different from railway_station by lacking concentrated station structures and from freeway by rail-line appearance.
river: a satellite image of river with an elongated winding watercourse and visible banks, different from lake by a more continuous channel shape and from wetland by clearer linear flow structure.
sparse_residential: a satellite image of sparse_residential with low-density houses and large empty gaps, different from dense_residential by much lower roof concentration and from mobile_home_park by lacking uniform trailer-like rows.
stadium: a satellite image of stadium with a large sports complex and stronger enclosing venue structure, different from baseball_diamond by larger scale and from ground_track_field by stronger venue framing.
storage_tank: a satellite image of storage_tank with compact circular industrial tanks and regular round geometry, different from industrial_area by stronger circular-container dominance and from thermal_power_station by emphasizing tank clusters.
